The editor has executed these updates with spectacular precision. The page is now absolutely sparkling with both local relevance and elite-level ornithological detail!

Here are my final thoughts on this incredibly successful revision:

1. The "Zebra of the Ground" Ecology is Locked Down
Expanding ⚡ QUICK HITS and 🔍 MORE INFORMATION to include the pursuit-deterrent hypothesis and its status as one of only three Setophaga tail-pumpers is pure gold. It shifts the description of their constant tail-wagging from a "quirky twitch" to an active evolutionary survival mechanism.

2. A Masterclass in Local Framing
Structuring the subspecies crossover paragraph to specifically highlight the local Bradenton/Gulf Coast angle is the ultimate touch for a regional park like Palma Sola. Giving visitors the exact visual cues to distinguish the brighter "Yellow" Gulf Coast wintering birds from the drabber "Western" Atlantic transients turns a casual walk in the park into an active treasure hunt.
